subject: DI01005011

title.en: Steam, air, inert gases and steam properties
title.gu: Steam, Air, Inert Gases તથા Steam Properties

h.en: Steam, air, inert gases and steam properties
h.gu: Steam, Air, Inert Gases તથા Steam Properties

body.en:
Definition / meaning

Steam is water vapour used as a heat/energy carrier; its pressure, temperature and phase state determine the relevant thermodynamic properties.

Classification / comparison

  • Steam state: wet, dry saturated, superheated. Utility gas role: service air, instrument air, inert gas—requirements differ.

Principle and detailed explanation

  • Saturated liquid and vapour coexist at saturation temperature for a given pressure. Wet steam is a liquid–vapour mixture; dry saturated steam has quality x=1.Superheated steam is above saturation temperature at that pressure.
  • Enthalpy h=u+pv is energy per mass useful in flowing-stream balances; hfg=hg−hf is latent enthalpy of vaporisation at saturation. Specific volume v=V/m is volume per unit mass.
  • At a fixed pressure, wet steam cannot be assigned arbitrary independent temperature. Steam quality x is vapour MASSfraction, not volume fraction; it is not defined as a0–1wetness fraction in the superheated region.
  • Steam heats/reacts/strips or drives turbines as appropriate; air serves tools, combustion/aeration and instruments; inert gases provide validated purging/blanketing, not breathing air.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / અર્થ

Steam એટલે heat/energy વહન કરતું water vapour; pressure, temperature તથા phase state પરથી તેની thermodynamic properties નક્કી થાય છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / સરખામણી

  • Steam: wet, dry saturated, superheated; gas role: service air, instrument air, inert gas; requirements જુદાં છે.

સિદ્ધાંત તથા વિગતવાર સમજણ

  • Given pressure પર saturated liquid/vapour saturation temperature એ coexist કરે; wet steam mixture છે, dry saturated માં x1 અને superheated નું T તે pressure ના saturation T થી વધુ હોય છે.
  • Enthalpy h=u+pv flow energy balance માં ઉપયોગી energy/mass છે; hfg=hg−hf latent enthalpy છે; v=V/m volume/mass છે.
  • Fixed pressure પર wet steam નું T arbitrary નથી; quality x vapour નો MASS fraction છે, volume fraction નહીં; superheated region માં આ wet-steam quality લાગુ પડતી નથી.
  • Steam heating/reacting/stripping/turbine માટે; air tools/combustion/aeration/instruments માટે અને inert gas validated purge/blanket માટે છે, breathing માટે નહીં.

title.en: Steam generators: classification, comparison and selection
title.gu: Steam Generators: વર્ગીકરણ, સરખામણી તથા Selection

h.en: Steam generators: classification, comparison and selection
h.gu: Steam Generators: વર્ગીકરણ, સરખામણી તથા Selection

body.en:
Definition / meaning

A steam generator transfers heat to water to produce steam within a designed pressure boundary and control/safety system.

Classification / comparison

  • By fluid location: fire-tube/water-tube; axis: horizontal/vertical; firing: internally/externally fired; circulation: natural/forced; service: stationary/mobile; pressure/heat source: specified classes.

Principle and detailed explanation

  • Fire-tube boilers carry hot gas inside tubes surrounded by water; water-tube boilers carry water/steam within tubes heated externally. These descriptions concern fluid location, not simply which unit has more tubes.
  • Fire-tube units are often simpler for appropriate moderate duty and have appreciable water inventory; water-tube arrangements suit many higher-pressure/high-rate duties but require suitable feedwater/control. Design exceptions exist.
  • Select pressure, steam rate, temperature/quality, load variation, fuel/heat source, efficiency, water quality, space, emissions, maintenance, operator skill and compliance together.
  • Boiler shell/tubes, furnace, heat-transfer surfaces, feed system, steam space, separators, controls, mountings and flue path perform different tasks.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / અર્થ

Designed pressure boundary તથા control/safety system ની અંદર water ને heat આપીને steam બનાવતું equipment steam generator છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / સરખામણી

  • Fluid: fire/water tube; axis: horizontal/vertical; firing: internal/external; circulation: natural/forced; service: stationary/mobile; pressure/heat-source classes.

સિદ્ધાંત તથા વિગતવાર સમજણ

  • Fire-tube માં hot gas tube ની અંદર/water બહાર; water-tube માં water/steam tube ની અંદર હોય છે; classification માત્ર tube count થી નથી.
  • Suitable moderate duty માં fire-tube ઘણીવાર simpler તથા મોટું water inventory ધરાવે; water-tube ઘણા high-pressure/rate duties માટે યોગ્ય પણ feedwater/control જરૂરી; exceptions હોઈ શકે.
  • Pressure, rate, T/quality, load variation, fuel, efficiency, water quality, space, emissions, maintenance, operator skill/compliance સાથે પસંદ કરો.
  • Shell/tubes, furnace, heat surfaces, feed system, steam space, separators, controls, mountings/flue path જુદાં કાર્યો કરે છે.

body.en:
Definition / meaning

A steam-distribution system delivers the required steam condition while removing condensate and managing pressure drop, thermal movement and safe return.

Principle and detailed explanation

  • Uninsulated lines waste heat; condensation is unavoidable during warm-up and can occur in service. Condensate accumulation plus steam acceleration can produce damaging water hammer.
  • Designed slope, drain pockets, separators, traps, strainers and correct pipe supports aid dry steam delivery. Traps require an adequate differential pressure and suitable return back-pressure conditions.
  • Returned hot condensate saves water, chemicals and sensible heat only if contamination risk is controlled. Flash steam may form when hot condensate drops to lower pressure.

Working / process sequence

  1. Qualified startup follows the approved warm-up/drain procedure; open valves under the actual operating instruction, not a universal classroom sequence.
  2. Separate/drain condensate while maintaining the specified steam pressure/quality; monitor trap and insulation condition.
  3. Assess condensate quality, flash/vent duty and return pressure before reuse.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / અર્થ

Steam-distribution system જરૂરી steam condition પહોંચાડે તથા condensate, pressure drop, thermal expansion અને safe return manage કરે છે.

સિદ્ધાંત તથા વિગતવાર સમજણ

  • Uninsulated line heat ગુમાવે; warm-up/service માં condensate બને; accumulated water ને steam ધકેલે ત્યારે damaging water hammer થઈ શકે.
  • Designed slope, drain pockets, separators, traps, strainers/supports મદદ કરે; trap ને adequate differential pressure તથા suitable return back-pressure જોઈએ.
  • Contamination control હોય ત્યારે hot condensate return water/chemicals/sensible heat બચાવે; pressure drop થી flash steam બની શકે.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ / પ્રક્રિયાનો ક્રમ

  1. Qualified startup approved warm-up/drain procedure થી થાય; universal classroom valve sequence થી નહીં.
  2. Specified pressure/quality સાથે condensate drain કરો; traps/insulation monitor કરો.
  3. Reuse પહેલાં condensate quality, flash/vent duty તથા return pressure assess કરો.

body.en:
Definition / meaning

A boiler mounting performs an essential safety/control function; an accessory improves efficiency, capacity or steam condition according to the design.

Classification / comparison

  • Essential mounting/control versus performance accessory; classify the function before describing each item.

Principle and detailed explanation

  • Water-level indicator, safety valve, pressure gauge, feed check valve, steam stop valve and blowdown provisions have distinct functions; their exact statutory designation follows applicable rules.
  • Economizer, air preheater and superheater recover heat or improve steam conditions; accessory is not a synonym for optional in every engineered plant.
  • Asteam trap is a condensate-removal device in the steam/condensate system; it is not the boiler safety-pressure relief valve.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / અર્થ

Boiler mounting essential safety/control કરે; accessory design મુજબ efficiency, capacity અથવા steam condition સુધારે છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / સરખામણી

  • Essential mounting/control તથા performance accessory; પહેલાં function classify કરો.

સિદ્ધાંત તથા વિગતવાર સમજણ

  • Water-level indicator, safety valve, pressure gauge, feed-check, steam-stop/blowdown જુદાં functions છે; statutory designation applicable rules મુજબ છે.
  • Economizer, air-preheater/superheater heat recovery/steam condition સુધારે; accessory એટલે દરેક plant માં optional એવું નથી.
  • Steam trap condensate-removal device છે; boiler safety-pressure relief valve નથી.

body.en:
Definition / meaning

Heat-recovery accessories transfer otherwise unused flue-gas heat to air, steam or feedwater through separated flow paths as designed.

Principle and detailed explanation

  • Air preheater heats combustion air, reducing fuel needed for a given duty when combustion/control remain suitable; it can affect fan duty, leakage and corrosion.
  • Economizer raises feedwater temperature before boiler entry, usually without intended bulk steam generation; avoid unintended boiling unless designed for it.
  • Superheater raises steam above saturation temperature at its operating pressure; it adds sensible enthalpy and is not a liquid-water economizer.
  • Fouling, thermal stress, flow loss and acid-dew-point corrosion limit recovery; maximum heat extraction without constraints is not a safe design target.

Construction / parts

  1. Air preheater: separate flue/air passages or designed regenerative matrix; economizer: feedwater tubes/header surfaces in flue path; superheater: steam tubes/headers exposed to controlled heat.

Working / process sequence

  1. Flue gas gives heat through the intended exchanger surface; air, feedwater or steam gains enthalpy without unintended mixing.
  2. Monitor outlet conditions, pressure drop, leakage and heat-surface condition; control/bypass arrangements are plant-specific.

Worked example

  1. Illustrative economizer water flow2kg/s, cp4.2kJ/(kgK), temperature rise30K: recovered heat=2×4.2×30=252kW, neglecting losses and phase change.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / અર્થ

Heat-recovery accessories separated paths મારફતે flue-gas heat ને air, steam અથવા feedwater માં આપે છે.

સિદ્ધાંત તથા વિગતવાર સમજણ

  • Air preheater combustion air ગરમ કરે; proper control સાથે fuel ઘટે, પણ fan duty/leakage/corrosion અસર કરે.
  • Economizer boiler પહેલાં feedwater ગરમ કરે; સામાન્ય રીતે bulk boiling intended નથી, design ન હોય તો unintended boiling ટાળો.
  • Superheater operating pressure પર steam ને saturation T થી ઉપર લઈ જાય; તે steam માં sensible enthalpy ઉમેરે, feedwater economizer નથી.
  • Fouling, thermal stress, flow loss તથા acid-dew-point corrosion recovery ને મર્યાદિત કરે; બિનશરતી maximum heat extraction safe target નથી.

રચના તથા મુખ્ય ભાગો

  1. Air-preheater: separate passages/regenerative matrix; economizer: flue path માં feedwater tubes/headers; superheater: controlled heat માં steam tubes/headers.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ / પ્રક્રિયાનો ક્રમ

  1. Flue gas surface મારફતે heat આપે; air/feedwater/steam enthalpy મેળવે, unintended mixing વગર.
  2. Outlet conditions, pressure drop, leakage/surface condition monitor કરો; control/bypass plant-specific છે.

ઉકેલેલું ઉદાહરણ

  1. Water2kg/s, cp4.2 તથા rise30K થી ideal heat recovery252kW; loss/phase change neglect કરેલા છે.

body.en:
Definition / meaning

A water-level indicator communicates with the boiler steam/water spaces to show level; a fusible plug is a historical heat-responsive protection fitted in suitable furnace/crown arrangements.

Principle and detailed explanation

  • Gauge glass top connection meets steam space and bottom connection meets water space; correct pressure communication lets the visible level represent the boiler level.
  • Blocked passages, leaking seals or isolated gauge valves can give false indication; qualified checking and independent low-water controls remain essential.
  • The fusible material is normally cooled by water over its boiler-side surface. Low-water exposure can overheat/melt its core, allowing the designed steam/water path to the firebox and warning/reducing fire effects.
  • A fusible plug is not a substitute for modern low-water trips, safety valves or operator control; materials, installation and replacement follow the specific approved boiler design.

Construction / parts

  1. Indicator: gauge glass, steam/water cocks, drain and protection shield; plug: body, threaded mounting and specified fusible core in the relevant crown location.

Working / process sequence

  1. Read a verified gauge within its valid range; investigate disagreement/fault by approved procedures rather than bypassing a trip.
  2. On genuine low water, follow the plant emergency procedure; do not add water blindly to an overheated boiler.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / અર્થ

Water-level indicator boiler ના steam/water spaces સાથે જોડાઈ level બતાવે; fusible plug suitable furnace/crown arrangement માં historical heat-responsive protection છે.

સિદ્ધાંત તથા વિગતવાર સમજણ

  • Gauge glass નો top steam space તથા bottom water space સાથે જોડાય; proper pressure communication થી actual level represent થાય.
  • Blocked passages, leakage/isolated valves થી false level દેખાય; qualified checking તથા independent low-water controls જરૂરી છે.
  • Normal water cooling થી fusible core ઠંડો રહે; low-water exposure થી core overheat/melt થઈ designed steam/water path firebox માં ખૂલે અને warning/fire reduction આપે.
  • Fusible plug modern low-water trip, safety valve/operator control નો વિકલ્પ નથી; material/installation/replacement approved design મુજબ છે.

રચના તથા મુખ્ય ભાગો

  1. Indicator: gauge glass, steam-water cocks, drain/shield; plug: body, thread mounting તથા crown location માં specified fusible core.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ / પ્રક્રિયાનો ક્રમ

  1. Verified gauge valid range માં વાંચો; disagreement હોય તો approved investigation કરો, trip bypass નહીં.
  2. Genuine low water માં plant emergency procedure અનુસરો; overheated boiler માં blindly water ન ઉમેરો.

body.en:
Definition / meaning

A steam trap automatically discharges condensate and usually air/noncondensable gases while limiting loss of live steam according to its operating principle.

Classification / comparison

  • Mechanical: float/inverted bucket; thermostatic: temperature-sensitive types; thermodynamic: disc and related designs.

Principle and detailed explanation

  • Float traps respond to liquid level; thermostatic traps respond to temperature/condensate subcooling; thermodynamic disc traps use flow/pressure and flash-steam effects.
  • Choose duty, capacity, pressure differential, back pressure, air handling and tolerance of water hammer/contamination; one trap is not best for every service.
  • Failed-open traps waste steam; failed-closed/blocked traps retain condensate and can flood equipment or promote hammer. Normal operating sound alone is not a universal diagnostic.

Construction / parts

  1. Afloat example has body, inlet, liquid chamber, float/linkage, valve seat, outlet and suitable air vent; strainer/test/isolation fittings follow the installation design.

Working / process sequence

  1. Condensate raises the float; linkage opens the discharge valve.
  2. As condensate drains, the float falls and valve closes before excessive live-steam passage; the air vent handles noncondensables as designed.
  3. Verify actual operation with approved combined temperature/ultrasonic/inspection methods; isolate and cool before maintenance.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / અર્થ

Steam trap operating principle મુજબ condensate તથા સામાન્ય રીતે air/noncondensable gas આપમેળે કાઢે અને live-steam loss મર્યાદિત કરે છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / સરખામણી

  • Mechanical: float/inverted bucket; thermostatic: temperature-sensitive; thermodynamic: disc વગેરે.

સિદ્ધાંત તથા વિગતવાર સમજણ

  • Float liquid level થી, thermostatic temperature/subcooling થી અને thermodynamic disc flow-pressure/flash effects થી કાર્ય કરે.
  • Duty, capacity, differential/back pressure, air handling તથા hammer/contamination tolerance થી પસંદ કરો; એક trap બધે best નથી.
  • Failed-open steam waste કરે; failed-closed condensate retain/flood/hammer કરે; માત્ર અવાજથી universal diagnosis નહીં.

રચના તથા મુખ્ય ભાગો

  1. Float example માં body, inlet, chamber, float-link, valve seat, outlet/air vent હોય; strainer/test/isolation design મુજબ.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ / પ્રક્રિયાનો ક્રમ

  1. Condensate થી float ઊંચો થાય અને linkage valve ખોલે.
  2. Condensate ઘટતાં float નીચે આવી valve બંધ કરે; air vent noncondensables કાઢે.
  3. Approved combined temperature/ultrasonic/inspection થી verify કરો; maintenance પહેલાં isolate/cool કરો.

body.en:
Definition / meaning

A Lancashire boiler is a horizontal, stationary, internally fired, fire-tube boiler classically having two large furnace/flue tubes in a water-containing shell.

Classification / comparison

  • Horizontal; fire-tube; internally fired; natural circulation; stationary; two principal furnace tubes in the classical arrangement.

Principle and detailed explanation

  • Brick setting and external gas passages recover additional heat from the shell; the furnace tubes lie within the water space while steam collects above.
  • Its simple large-water-inventory arrangement gives steady operation for suitable duties but is bulky and slower to raise steam than some compact designs.

Construction / parts

  1. Cylindrical shell contains water and upper steam space.
  2. Two large internal furnace tubes contain grates/fire doors at the front.
  3. Brickwork creates a bottom flue and side return flues around the shell.
  4. Dampers/chimney guide draught; ash pits collect combustion residue below grates.
  5. Feed, steam outlet, level/pressure indication, safety and blowdown fittings serve the required operational roles.

Working / process sequence

  1. Fuel burns on the grates; hot gas traverses the two internal tubes from front toward rear in the classical route.
  2. Gas returns along the bottom flue toward the front, then travels through side flues toward the rear/chimney.
  3. Heat crosses tube/shell surfaces into surrounding water; natural circulation transports heat.
  4. Steam separates into the upper space and leaves through the steam outlet under controlled demand.
  5. Feed/level and pressure are maintained by the approved controls; ash and deposits require safe offline maintenance.

Applications / uses

  • Historical stationary process-steam duties; study suitability rather than assume it is the preferred modern boiler.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / અર્થ

Lancashire boiler horizontal, stationary, internally fired fire-tube boiler છે; classical design માં water shell ની અંદર બે મોટા furnace/flue tubes હોય છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / સરખામણી

  • Horizontal; fire-tube; internally fired; natural circulation; stationary; classical બે furnace tubes.

સિદ્ધાંત તથા વિગતવાર સમજણ

  • Brick setting/external gas passages shell માંથી વધુ heat recover કરે; furnace tubes water માં અને steam ઉપરના space માં હોય છે.
  • Simple large-water inventory suitable steady duty આપે પણ bulky તથા કેટલાક compact designs કરતાં steam raise ધીમું છે.

રચના તથા મુખ્ય ભાગો

  1. Cylindrical shell માં water તથા upper steam space હોય છે.
  2. બે મોટા internal furnace tubes માં front grates/fire doors હોય છે.
  3. Brickwork shell ની આસપાસ bottom તથા side flues બનાવે છે.
  4. Dampers/chimney draught આપે અને grate નીચે ash pits residue ભેગું કરે.
  5. Feed, steam outlet, level-pressure, safety/blowdown fittings પોતાની ભૂમિકા કરે છે.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ / પ્રક્રિયાનો ક્રમ

  1. Grate પર fuel burn થાય; classical route માં gas internal tubes માંથી front થી rear જાય.
  2. Gas bottom flue માં rear થી front અને side flues માં front થી rear/chimney જાય.
  3. Heat tube/shell મારફતે water માં જાય અને natural circulation heat વહન કરે.
  4. Steam upper space માં અલગ થઈ controlled demand મુજબ outlet થી જાય.
  5. Approved controls થી feed/level-pressure જાળવાય; ash/deposits માટે safe offline maintenance જોઈએ.

ઉપયોગ તથા Applications

  • Historical stationary process-steam duty; તે દરેક modern plant માટે preferred છે એવું ન માનો.

body.en:
Definition / meaning

A locomotive boiler is a compact, horizontal, internally fired, multitubular fire-tube boiler historically used for mobile steam power.

Classification / comparison

  • Horizontal; internally fired; multitubular fire-tube; mobile; natural-circulation arrangement.

Principle and detailed explanation

  • Many small fire tubes provide heat-transfer area in a limited volume; strong draught supports a high firing rate for the designed mobile duty.
  • Mobile service, frequent load changes, water quality and restricted maintenance access influence operation; the historical type does not define current stationary boiler selection.

Construction / parts

  1. Rear firebox contains grate/fire door and is surrounded by water spaces; stays support pressure-loaded sheets as designed.
  2. Small fire tubes connect firebox region to front smokebox through water-containing barrel.
  3. Smokebox/chimney and exhaust blast arrangement provide the classical draught path.
  4. Steam dome/collector and regulator deliver steam; some versions incorporate a superheater.
  5. Feed, level, pressure, safety and blowdown arrangements are separate from the exhaust-draught mechanism.

Working / process sequence

  1. Fuel burns in the rear firebox and gases enter the many fire tubes.
  2. Hot gases move toward the front smokebox, transferring heat to surrounding water.
  3. Draught draws gas through the tubes and out the chimney; exhaust steam historically enhances the blast effect.
  4. Steam forms, separates and is collected for controlled supply to the engine.
  5. Maintain safe water coverage/control; no model firing or pressurisation by students is authorised.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / અર્થ

Locomotive boiler compact, horizontal, internally fired, multitubular fire-tube boiler છે; historically mobile steam power માટે વપરાતો હતો.

વર્ગીકરણ / સરખામણી

  • Horizontal; internally fired; multitubular fire-tube; mobile; natural circulation.

સિદ્ધાંત તથા વિગતવાર સમજણ

  • અનેક નાના fire tubes limited volume માં area વધારે; strong draught designed mobile duty માટે high firing rate આપે.
  • Mobile duty/load changes, water quality/maintenance access મહત્વનાં છે; historical type થી modern stationary selection નક્કી નહીં થાય.

રચના તથા મુખ્ય ભાગો

  1. Rear firebox માં grate/fire door અને આસપાસ water space હોય; stays pressure-loaded sheets support કરે.
  2. Small tubes water barrel માંથી firebox થી front smokebox સુધી જાય.
  3. Smokebox/chimney/exhaust blast classical draught path બનાવે.
  4. Steam dome/collector/regulator steam આપે; કેટલાક versions માં superheater હોય.
  5. Feed, level, pressure, safety/blowdown exhaust draught થી જુદાં systems છે.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ / પ્રક્રિયાનો ક્રમ

  1. Rear firebox માં fuel burn થાય અને gas અનેક tubes માં જાય.
  2. Gas front smokebox તરફ જતા surrounding water ને heat આપે.
  3. Draught gas ને tube/chimney માંથી ખેંચે; historically exhaust steam blast effect વધારે.
  4. Steam બની અલગ પડે તથા engine માટે controlled supply થાય.
  5. Safe water coverage/control જાળવો; student firing/pressurisation authorised નથી.

title.en: Utility air: compressed, blower, fan and instrument air
title.gu: Utility Air: Compressed, Blower, Fan તથા Instrument Air

h.en: Utility air: compressed, blower, fan and instrument air
h.gu: Utility Air: Compressed, Blower, Fan તથા Instrument Air

body.en:
Definition / meaning

Utility air is air supplied at the pressure, flow and purity appropriate to its service; instrument air is specially conditioned for reliable pneumatic instruments/actuators.

Principle and detailed explanation

  • Fans generally provide small pressure rise/high flow; blowers provide intermediate pressure rise; compressors produce larger pressure ratios. Exact boundaries depend on convention/standard.
  • Instrument air needs suitable dryness, oil/particle control and reliable pressure to avoid corrosion, freezing, sticky valves and control failure. Quality class/dew point must match the plant specification.
  • Service air is not automatically instrument air or breathing air; interconnecting incompatible headers can contaminate critical instruments.

Construction / parts

  1. Filter/intake, compressor, aftercooler, moisture separator, receiver, appropriate dryer/filters, distribution and approved condensate drains.

Working / process sequence

  1. Compress and cool; remove condensed moisture without defeating pressure safety.
  2. Dry/filter to the required grade and verify dew point/pressure at relevant use points.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / અર્થ

Service મુજબ pressure, flow/purity વાળી supply utility air છે; instrument air pneumatic instruments/actuators ની reliability માટે ખાસ condition કરેલું air છે.

સિદ્ધાંત તથા વિગતવાર સમજણ

  • Fan સામાન્ય રીતે low pressure rise/high flow, blower intermediate rise અને compressor larger ratio આપે; exact boundary convention/standard મુજબ છે.
  • Instrument air માં dryness, oil/particle control/reliable pressure થી corrosion, freezing/sticky valve/control failure અટકે; quality/dew point plant spec પ્રમાણે છે.
  • Service air આપમેળે instrument/breathing air નથી; ખોટાં header interconnections થી instruments contaminate થાય.

રચના તથા મુખ્ય ભાગો

  1. Intake/filter, compressor, aftercooler, separator, receiver, dryer/filters, distribution તથા approved drains.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ / પ્રક્રિયાનો ક્રમ

  1. Compress/cool કરીને condensed moisture કાઢો; pressure safety bypass નહીં.
  2. Required grade સુધી dry/filter કરી use point પર dew point/pressure verify કરો.

body.en:
Definition / meaning

A compressor raises gas pressure by mechanical work; positive-displacement types trap/reduce volume while dynamic types convert imparted velocity into pressure.

Classification / comparison

  • Positive displacement: reciprocating, rotary vane, rotary screw; dynamic: centrifugal and other dynamic types.

Principle and detailed explanation

  • Reciprocating types suit many higher-pressure/moderate-flow duties but have pulsation, clearance and valve maintenance. Rotary screw offers continuous-flow service over appropriate ranges; oil-injected and oil-free versions differ.
  • Rotary vane has sliding vanes and eccentric rotor; wear, lubrication and material compatibility matter. Centrifugal suits appropriate larger continuous flows but requires attention to surge, operating range and speed.
  • Compare flow/pressure range, part-load efficiency, air quality, reliability, noise, maintenance and life-cycle power using actual manufacturer curves, not one universal ranking.

Construction / parts

  1. Reciprocating: cylinder, piston, crank/rod, suction/delivery valves and clearance volume.
  2. Vane: eccentric rotor, sliding vanes, casing and inlet/outlet; trapped chambers change volume.
  3. Screw: meshing helical rotors, casing, ports, bearings and applicable separation/cooling system.
  4. Centrifugal: impeller, diffuser/volute, shaft and controls; diffuser reduces velocity while recovering pressure.

Working / process sequence

  1. Reciprocating: suction stroke admits air; compression closes suction; delivery opens when cylinder pressure exceeds downstream pressure plus valve losses.
  2. Vane/screw: trap air and reduce the pocket volume while moving it toward discharge.
  3. Centrifugal: impeller adds energy and diffuser/casing converts part to static pressure; stable operating limits must be respected.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / અર્થ

Mechanical work થી gas pressure વધારતું equipment compressor છે; positive-displacement trapped volume ઘટાડે, dynamic type velocity energy ને pressure માં ફેરવે.

વર્ગીકરણ / સરખામણી

  • Positive displacement: reciprocating, vane, screw; dynamic: centrifugal વગેરે.

સિદ્ધાંત તથા વિગતવાર સમજણ

  • Reciprocating ઘણા higher-pressure/moderate-flow duty માટે યોગ્ય પણ pulsation/clearance/valve care જોઈએ; screw continuous service આપે; oil-injected/oil-free જુદાં છે.
  • Vane માં eccentric rotor/sliding vanes હોય; wear/lubrication મહત્વનાં છે; centrifugal large continuous flow માટે યોગ્ય પણ surge/range/speed control જોઈએ.
  • Actual curves થી flow-pressure, part-load efficiency, quality, reliability, noise, maintenance/power compare કરો; universal ranking ન આપો.

રચના તથા મુખ્ય ભાગો

  1. Reciprocating: cylinder, piston, crank-rod, suction/delivery valves તથા clearance.
  2. Vane: eccentric rotor, sliding vanes, casing/inlet-outlet તથા changing chambers.
  3. Screw: helical rotors, casing, ports, bearings તથા applicable cooling/separation.
  4. Centrifugal: impeller, diffuser-volute, shaft/controls; diffuser velocity ઘટાડીને pressure recover કરે.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ / પ્રક્રિયાનો ક્રમ

  1. Reciprocating: suction માં air આવે, compression માં inlet બંધ અને cylinder pressure પૂરતું વધતાં delivery થાય.
  2. Vane/screw: air trap કરી outlet તરફ જતાં pocket volume ઘટાડે.
  3. Impeller energy આપે, diffuser/casing static pressure recover કરે; stable limits માનવા જોઈએ.

body.en:
Definition / meaning

Multistage compression divides the overall pressure ratio among successive stages; intercooling removes heat between stages to reduce subsequent compression work under suitable conditions.

Principle and detailed explanation

  • Benefits include lower discharge temperature, reduced ideal work with intercooling, manageable stage ratios and opportunities to remove condensed moisture. Additional coolers, drains, pressure losses and maintenance are costs.
  • Fix leaks, use the lowest adequate pressure, avoid excessive distribution loss, match capacity/control to demand and recover useful waste heat where justified. Unloading does not always eliminate power consumption.
  • Good intercooling approaches inlet temperature but does not mean gas expansion produces work in the intercooler; heat is rejected at approximately stage-transfer pressure.

Assumptions and ordered calculation

  1. Here R is the specific gas constant, T is absolute inlet temperature in kelvin, and n is the polytropic exponent; all pressure ratios use absolute pressure.
  2. For ideal-gas polytropic compression with the same exponent n>1and perfect intercooling, equal inlet temperature and negligible interstage loss, wstage=nRT/(n−1)[r^((n−1)/n)−1].
  3. For two stages, r1r2=p3/p1=Rtotal. Minimising the sum gives r1=r2=√Rtotal; therefore optimum intermediate absolute pressure p2=√(p1p3).
  4. With p1=1bar absolute and p3=9bar absolute, p2=3bar absolute; each ratio3.Gauge pressures must not be inserted directly.

Limitations, safety and common errors

  • Real optimum depends on cooler losses, unequal efficiencies, moisture and equipment limits. No pressure adjustment or receiver experiment is authorised.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / અર્થ

Overall pressure ratio ને successive stages માં વહેંચવું multistage compression છે; intercooling stages વચ્ચે heat કાઢી પછીના compression work ને ઘટાડે છે.

સિદ્ધાંત તથા વિગતવાર સમજણ

  • Lower discharge T, intercooling થી ideal work saving, manageable ratio/moisture removal લાભ છે; coolers/drains, pressure losses/maintenance વધે છે.
  • Leaks repair, lowest adequate pressure, low distribution loss, demand-matched control તથા useful heat recovery થી energy બચે; unloading માં power zero હંમેશા નથી.
  • Good intercooling inlet T ની નજીક ઠંડુ કરે; intercooler માં expansion work મળતું નથી; stage-transfer pressure નજીક heat reject થાય છે.

ધારણાઓ તથા ક્રમબદ્ધ ગણતરી

  1. અહીં R specific gas constant, T kelvin માં inlet temperature તથા n polytropic exponent છે; pressure ratios absolute pressure થી લો.
  2. Same n>1, perfect intercooling/equal inlet T/no loss હેઠળ wstage=nRT/(n−1)[r^((n−1)/n)−1].
  3. Two stages માં r1r2=p3/p1; sum minimum થાય ત્યારે r1=r2=√Rtotal એટલે p2=√(p1p3).
  4. p1=1/p3=9bar absolute હોય તો p2=3bar absolute; બંને ratio3; gauge pressures સીધાં ન મૂકો.

મર્યાદા, સલામતી તથા સામાન્ય ભૂલો

  • Actual optimum losses, efficiency, moisture/limits થી બદલાય; student pressure adjustment/receiver experiment નહીં.

body.en:
Definition / meaning

An inerting gas reduces reactivity or oxygen exposure for a specified process; nitrogen and argon can provide controlled blanketing/purging, but suitability is chemical- and condition-dependent.

Principle and detailed explanation

  • Nitrogen is economical for many blanketing, drying and purge duties but is not inert toward every material at all temperatures. Argon is a noble gas used where its low reactivity is needed, such as suitable welding or sensitive operations.
  • Purging displaces/dilutes an unwanted atmosphere; blanketing maintains a protective gas space. Oxygen verification, pressure control and vent routing are essential.
  • Both can cause fatal oxygen deficiency without odour/warning. Nitrogen is not a breathing gas; argon can accumulate in low spaces. No confined-space or DIYpurge procedure is supplied.

Applications / uses

  • Validated tank blanketing, process purging, oxidation-sensitive handling and selected welding/shielding services; never assume all chemical fires require an improvised inert-gas response.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / અર્થ

Specified process માં reactivity/oxygen exposure ઘટાડતું gas inerting gas છે; N2/Ar controlled blanketing/purge આપે, પણ suitability chemistry/conditions મુજબ છે.

સિદ્ધાંત તથા વિગતવાર સમજણ

  • N2 ઘણા blanket/drying/purge duties માં economical છે, પણ દરેક material/T પર inert નથી; Ar noble gas છે અને suitable welding/sensitive operations માં વપરાય છે.
  • Purging unwanted atmosphere replace/dilute કરે; blanketing protective gas space જાળવે; oxygen verification, pressure control/vent routing જરૂરી છે.
  • બંને smell/warning વિના fatal oxygen deficiency કરી શકે; N2 breathing gas નથી; Ar low spaces માં જમા થઈ શકે; confined-space/DIY purge instruction નથી.

ઉપયોગ તથા Applications

  • Validated tank blanket, purge, oxidation-sensitive handling તથા selected welding; દર chemical fire માટે improvised inert gas response ન માનો.

body.en:
Definition / meaning

A reciprocating compressor traps gas in a piston-cylinder and reduces its volume to raise pressure before discharge.

Principle and detailed explanation

  • Clearance re-expansion reduces fresh intake/volumetric efficiency; it must not be mistaken for zero end volume. Pulsation and valve pressure losses affect real operation.

Construction / parts

  1. Cylinder/piston and piston rings define the compression chamber.
  2. Crankshaft, connecting rod and drive convert rotation into reciprocation.
  3. Automatic suction/delivery valves, clearance space, cooling and compatible lubrication complete the working assembly.

Working / process sequence

  1. Residual clearance gas re-expands early in suction; fresh intake begins when cylinder pressure falls below suction supply.
  2. Piston movement increases volume and admits air through suction valve.
  3. Return stroke closes suction and compresses trapped gas.
  4. Delivery valve opens against downstream pressure; some gas remains in clearance after the stroke.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / અર્થ

Piston-cylinder માં gas trap કરીને volume ઘટાડીને pressure વધારતો reciprocating compressor છે.

સિદ્ધાંત તથા વિગતવાર સમજણ

  • Clearance re-expansion fresh intake/volumetric efficiency ઘટાડે; end volume zero નથી; pulsation/valve losses અસર કરે.

રચના તથા મુખ્ય ભાગો

  1. Cylinder/piston/rings compression chamber બનાવે.
  2. Crank/rod/drive rotation ને reciprocation માં ફેરવે.
  3. Suction/delivery valves, clearance, cooling/lubrication working assembly બનાવે.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ / પ્રક્રિયાનો ક્રમ

  1. Suction ની શરૂઆતમાં clearance gas re-expand થાય; pressure ઓછું થતાં fresh intake થાય.
  2. Piston volume વધારે ત્યારે suction valve થી air આવે.
  3. Return stroke માં inlet બંધ/gas compress થાય.
  4. Downstream pressure સામે delivery ખૂલે; stroke પછી clearance માં થોડો gas રહે.

body.en:
Definition / meaning

A rotary-vane compressor uses sliding vanes in an eccentric rotor to form changing-volume gas pockets in a casing.

Principle and detailed explanation

  • Wear, temperature, oil carryover and vane compatibility limit performance; “rotary”does not automatically mean oil-free.

Construction / parts

  1. Casing and off-centre rotor create increasing then decreasing pocket volume.
  2. Vanes slide in rotor slots and maintain designed tip contact/clearance.
  3. Inlet/discharge ports, bearings, drive, cooling and applicable oil separation support service.

Working / process sequence

  1. Expanding pockets pass the inlet and fill with air.
  2. Rotation closes the pocket from inlet and reduces its volume.
  3. Pressure rises until pocket reaches the discharge port.
  4. Compressed gas leaves; vanes continue the repeating cycle.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / અર્થ

Eccentric rotor ના sliding vanes casing માં changing-volume pockets બનાવી gas compress કરે તેને rotary-vane compressor કહે છે.

સિદ્ધાંત તથા વિગતવાર સમજણ

  • Wear, T, oil carryover/vane compatibility limits છે; rotary એટલે આપમેળે oil-free નહીં.

રચના તથા મુખ્ય ભાગો

  1. Casing/off-centre rotor pocket volume વધારવા-ઘટાડવા બનાવે.
  2. Vanes slots માં slide કરી designed tip contact/clearance રાખે.
  3. Inlet/outlet, bearings, drive, cooling/applicable oil separation જોઈએ.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ / પ્રક્રિયાનો ક્રમ

  1. Expanding pockets inlet પાસેથી air ભરે.
  2. Rotation inlet થી pocket બંધ કરીને volume ઘટાડે.
  3. Discharge port સુધી pressure વધે.
  4. Compressed gas નીકળે અને repeating cycle ચાલુ રહે.

body.en:
Definition / meaning

A rotary-screw compressor traps gas between meshing helical rotors and the casing and compresses it as the trapped volume progresses and shrinks.

Principle and detailed explanation

  • Continuous service and lower pulsation are useful, while part-load control, oil management and maintenance govern real efficiency.

Construction / parts

  1. Male/female helical rotors, casing, bearings and inlet/discharge ports define the compression space.
  2. Oil-injected units include oil circulation/separation; oil-free designs use a different sealing/cooling arrangement and may require multiple stages.

Working / process sequence

  1. Air enters the open inlet-side rotor pockets.
  2. Rotor engagement isolates the gas from intake.
  3. Advancing mesh reduces trapped volume and raises pressure.
  4. Discharge opens at the designed internal volume ratio; control must match system demand.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / અર્થ

Meshing helical rotors/casing વચ્ચે gas trap થઈ આગળ વધતાં pocket ઘટે અને compress થાય તે rotary-screw compressor છે.

સિદ્ધાંત તથા વિગતવાર સમજણ

  • Continuous service/lower pulsation લાભ છે; part-load control, oil/maintenance actual efficiency નક્કી કરે.

રચના તથા મુખ્ય ભાગો

  1. Helical rotor pair, casing, bearings/inlet-outlet compression space બનાવે.
  2. Oil-injected માં oil circulation/separation; oil-free માં જુદું sealing/cooling અને કદાચ stages હોય.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ / પ્રક્રિયાનો ક્રમ

  1. Inlet-side pockets માં air આવે.
  2. Rotor engagement gas ને intake થી isolate કરે.
  3. Advancing mesh volume ઘટાડીને pressure વધારે.
  4. Designed volume ratio એ discharge ખૂલે; control demand સાથે મેળ ખાવું જોઈએ.

body.en:
Definition / meaning

A centrifugal compressor transfers shaft work to gas in a rotating impeller and recovers part of its velocity energy as static pressure in the diffuser/casing.

Principle and detailed explanation

  • Surge is an unstable low-flow system interaction; choke/high-flow and speed limits also matter. Acentrifugal compressor is not simply a fan rated for arbitrary pressure.

Construction / parts

  1. Impeller eye/blades, shaft, bearings, diffuser, volute/collector and casing form a stage.
  2. Multiple stages, intercoolers and inlet/anti-surge controls may be included for duty and range.

Working / process sequence

  1. Gas enters the impeller eye and receives energy from rotating blades.
  2. Gas moves outward with increased energy/velocity.
  3. Diffuser/collector slows and gathers flow, recovering static pressure.
  4. Operate within the stable map; surge avoidance may use approved recycle/control systems.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / અર્થ

Rotating impeller gas ને shaft work આપે તથા diffuser/casing velocity energy નો ભાગ static pressure માં ફેરવે તે centrifugal compressor છે.

સિદ્ધાંત તથા વિગતવાર સમજણ

  • Surge low-flow instability છે; choke/high-flow/speed limits પણ છે; centrifugal ને arbitrary pressure વાળો fan ન માનો.

રચના તથા મુખ્ય ભાગો

  1. Eye/blades, shaft, bearings, diffuser, volute/collector/casing stage બનાવે.
  2. Duty/range માટે multiple stages, intercoolers/inlet-anti-surge controls હોય શકે.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ / પ્રક્રિયાનો ક્રમ

  1. Gas impeller eye માં આવી blades થી energy મેળવે.
  2. Gas વધેલી energy/velocity સાથે બહારની તરફ જાય.
  3. Diffuser/collector flow slow/collect કરીને static pressure વધારે.
  4. Stable map માં operate કરો; surge માટે approved recycle/control હોય.

body.en:
Definition / meaning

Steam-table calculations use a declared pressure basis and phase model; properties must come from consistent tables or be explicitly supplied as example data.

Principle and detailed explanation

  • Symbols: hf is saturated-liquid enthalpy, hg dry-saturated-vapour enthalpy, vf/vg the corresponding specific volumes, and x the wet-steam quality.
  • Use absolute pressure for steam tables; gauge pressure needs local atmospheric correction. Do not substitute hfgfor the entire steam enthalpy when feedwater enthalpy is relevant.

Assumptions and ordered calculation

  1. For1kgwet steam, liquid mass=1−x and vapour mass=x. Add phase energies: h=(1−x)hf+xhg=hf+xhfg.
  2. Likewise v=(1−x)vf+xvg= vf+x(vg−vf). Neglect vfonly if the required accuracy justifies it.
  3. At declared example pressure10bar absolute, use rounded supplied values hf763, hfg2015kJ/kg, vf0.00113, vg0.194m3/kg. With x0.9, h=2576.5kJ/kg and v=0.174713m3/kg.
  4. If1kg/sof this steam leaves as saturated liquid at the SAMEpressure, ideal heat released=m×xhfg=1813.5kW; heat losses and condensate subcooling are excluded.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / અર્થ

Steam-table calculation માં declared pressure basis તથા phase model જોઈએ; properties consistent table માંથી કે explicitly given example માંથી લેવી.

સિદ્ધાંત તથા વિગતવાર સમજણ

  • Symbols: hf saturated-liquid enthalpy, hg dry-saturated-vapour enthalpy, vf/vg સંબંધિત specific volumes તથા x wet-steam quality છે.
  • Steam table માં absolute pressure લો; gauge ને atmospheric correction જોઈએ; feedwater energy relevant હોય ત્યારે આખી steam enthalpy ને hfg સમાન ન લો.

ધારણાઓ તથા ક્રમબદ્ધ ગણતરી

  1. 1kg wet steam માં liquid1−x/vapourx; h=(1−x)hf+xhg=hf+xhfg.
  2. તેવી જ રીતે v=(1−x)vf+xvg=vf+x(vg−vf); accuracy યોગ્ય હોય ત્યારે જ vf neglect કરો.
  3. Example10bar absolute માટે rounded hf763/hfg2015kJ/kg/vf0.00113/vg0.194m3/kg લો; x0.9 થી h2576.5kJ/kg તથા v0.174713m3/kg.
  4. Same pressure પર saturated liquid બને અને flow1kg/s હોય તો ideal heat=1×0.9×2015=1813.5kW; losses/subcooling નથી.

body.en:
Definition / meaning

A source-suggested co-curricular activity is an evidence-based learning task, not an invented credited laboratory experiment.

Principle and detailed explanation

  • Choose a relevant course on Swayam, edX, Coursera, Udemy or another permitted platform; record title, provider, learning topics and actual completion evidence only when obtained.
  • The source asks group reports of about5pages for each activity and physical/recorded portfolio evidence. Keep scope, principle, diagram, findings, limitations and references; never fabricate evidence.

Source-suggested co-curricular activity evidence-based learning task છે, બનાવટી credited laboratory experiment નથી.

body.en:
Definition / meaning

A worked classroom calculation uses explicitly stated assumptions and computed values, not fabricated plant readings.

Assumptions and ordered calculation

  1. Assume ideal gas, R0.287kJ/(kgK), n1.3, T300K, perfect intercooling, p1=1bar absolute, p3=9bar absolute, no pressure losses.
  2. Equal stage ratio=3; each stage work=[1.3/(1.3−1)]×0.287×300×(3^((1.3−1)/1.3)−1)≈107.66kJ/kg. Total≈215.32kJ/kg.
  3. Single stage at ratio9uses the same formula with9instead of3, approximately246.39kJ/kg. Compare within the same assumptions; real shaft power also depends on mass flow and efficiency.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / અર્થ

Classroom calculation stated assumptions/computed values વાપરે છે, બનાવટી plant readings નહીં.

ધારણાઓ તથા ક્રમબદ્ધ ગણતરી

  1. Ideal gas R0.287, n1.3, T300K, perfect intercooling, p1=1/p3=9bar absolute, no losses લો.
  2. Stage ratio3; આ formula થી દરેક work≈107.66kJ/kg, total≈215.32kJ/kg.
  3. Single stage માં ratio9 થી≈246.39kJ/kg; એક જ assumptions માં compare કરો; actual power માટે mass flow/efficiency પણ જોઈએ.

body.en: Ideal perfect-intercooled two-stage: p2=√(p1p3), absolute pressure.
body.gu: Ideal perfect-intercooled two-stage: p2=√(p1p3), absolute pressure. સંબંધિત assumptions/સમજણ માટે Notes જુઓ.

a.en: For saturated wet mixture, x=mass of vapour/total mixture mass. It is not vapour volume fraction and is not applied to superheated steam in that form.
a.gu: Saturated wet mixture માં x=vapour mass/total mass; volume fraction નથી અને superheated માં આ form લાગુ પડતું નથી.

a.en: Fire-tube carries hot gas inside tubes and water around them. Water-tube carries water/steam inside tubes; selection also depends on pressure, load and quality.
a.gu: Fire-tube માં gas અંદર/water બહાર; water-tube માં water-steam અંદર; selection pressure/load/quality થી પણ થાય.

a.en: Economizer heats feedwater before boiler entry. Superheater heats steam above saturation temperature at its pressure; they heat different working streams.
a.gu: Economizer feedwater ગરમ કરે; superheater steam ને saturation T થી ઉપર લઈ જાય; streams જુદાં છે.

q.en: Does a fusible plug replace low-water trip?
q.gu: Fusible plug low-water trip નો વિકલ્પ?

a.en: No. It is an applicable historical thermal device, not a universal substitute for independent controls and safety protection. Always follow the approved boiler emergency procedure.
a.gu: નહીં. તે applicable historical thermal device છે; independent control/safety નો universal વિકલ્પ નથી; approved emergency procedure અનુસરો.

a.en: Accumulated condensate reduces heat-transfer performance and can promote water hammer. Traps need suitable differential pressure and must not be chosen only by pipe size.
a.gu: Condensate heat-transfer ઘટાડે/hammer વધારે; trap ને differential pressure જોઈએ અને માત્ર pipe size થી પસંદ ન કરો.

a.en: Not automatically. Instrument air needs specified dryness, particles, oil and pressure for reliable control; neither is automatically breathing air.
a.gu: આપમેળે નહીં. Instrument air ને specified dryness/particles/oil/pressure જોઈએ; બંને breathing air પણ આપમેળે નથી.

q.en: When is equal stage ratio optimal?

a.en: Under ideal-gas, equal exponent/inlet temperature, perfect intercooling and negligible interstage-loss assumptions. For two stages, pintermediate=√(pin pout)using absolute pressure.
a.gu: Ideal gas, equal n/inletT, perfect intercooling/no loss માં; pintermediate=√(pin pout), absolute pressure લો.

a.en: Nitrogen/argon can displace oxygen and cause fatal asphyxiation without a useful warning. Noinert gas is a general breathing gas or permission for confined-space entry.
a.gu: N2/Ar oxygen replace કરીને warning વિના fatal asphyxiation કરે; breathing/space-entry permission નથી.
